decision_semantics.ALERT: The analyst receives a forecast-based warning: the frozen screening criterion is crossed within the next 50 s.
decision_semantics.BENIGN: Current evidence and forecast do not cross the frozen screening criterion.
decision_semantics.ABSTAIN: The model output should NOT be acted upon automatically. Analyst review is recommended because reliability or decision-margin evidence is insufficient for an automated call. This is the model DECLINING TO DECIDE — not the model reporting an absence of signal. The forecast probability is still shown and still available to the analyst.

evaluation_order: 1. HARD SAFETY RULE: reliability == UNRELIABLE -> ABSTAIN (unconditional, no bypass)
2. VALIDATION-FROZEN GATE: |max_forecast - 0.69| < 0.05 -> ABSTAIN; or reliability == CAUTION -> ABSTAIN
3. OTHERWISE the frozen rule decides, unchanged: max_forecast > 0.69 -> ALERT else BENIGN
policy.alert_threshold_source: docs/v4_baseline_manifest.json -> threshold.per_horizon_trajectory_max['5'] (validation-selected, grid search np.arange(0.01, 0.99, 0.01), keep first threshold maximizing validation F1 (strict >))

margin_selection_rule.rule: among all grid deltas whose SELECTIVE F1 on the non-abstained validation windows is >= the no-abstain baseline validation F1, choose the LARGEST delta
margin_selection_rule.why_this_rule: A plain 'minimise selective error' rule is actively misleading on this data. The model's positive predictions cluster just above 0.69, so a wide margin band abstains on almost every ALERT and leaves a retained set that is ~82% negative. Error rate then falls simply because the retained classifier approaches 'always BENIGN' — an artefact of class imbalance, not a better decision. The F1 floor is therefore imposed as a CONSTRAINT: abstention must not be bought by discarding the operating point's recall. Error and FPR reduction are then a measured OUTCOME of the gate, never its optimisation target.

margin_evidence.caution_evidence_is_weak: only n=25 CAUTION windows exist on validation, so the CAUTION branch rests on a small sample and is reported as weak evidence, not as a measured effect
margin_evidence.unreliable_branch_note: the validation split contains ZERO UNRELIABLE windows, so the hard UNRELIABLE -> ABSTAIN rule could not be, and was not, tuned on data. It is a DECLARED SAFETY RULE inherited from Task 15, and its effect is only observable on test.

RELIABILITY_UNRELIABLE.text: Forecast reliability is UNRELIABLE — the Task-15 layer reports the forecast was produced outside the reference operating conditions (out-of-distribution input, rollout instability, or a hard numerical fail-safe).

RELIABILITY_CAUTION.text: Forecast reliability is CAUTION — one or more Task-15 indicators sit above the reference 99th percentile.

DECISION_MARGIN_NARROW.text: The forecast sits within the validation-derived abstention margin of the frozen 0.69 decision boundary, so the ALERT/BENIGN call would rest on a difference the validation split does not support resolving automatically.

rejected_signals.attack_path_status: REJECTED as a gate input. Measured on validation, the Task-16 status partitions EXACTLY on the 0.69 alert boundary (NO_FORWARD_PROGRESSION <=> alert=0; AMBIGUOUS and FORWARD_PROGRESSION <=> alert=1, 1473/1473 windows). It is downstream of the same threshold, so it carries no information independent of the ALERT/BENIGN bit and cannot inform the gate. It IS shown in the UI as decision RATIONALE, which is a different role.
rejected_signals.early_warning_status: REJECTED as a gate input. Early-warning status is defined relative to a DOCUMENTED ATTACK ONSET, so it is label-derived and only knowable retrospectively. Using it at decision time would be leakage. It appears in the retrospective reporting only.
rejected_signals.forecast_trajectory_consistency: INVESTIGATED, not adopted. Trajectory spread across k=1..5 is already an input to the Task-15 rollout-stability indicators, so adding it here would double-count the same evidence under a second, independently-chosen threshold.
rejected_signals.learned_confidence_mapping: NOT ATTEMPTED. No calibration was fitted, so no output of this layer is described as calibrated.

abstain_wording.headline: AUTOMATIC DECISION WITHHELD
abstain_wording.means: model declines to make an automated decision
